newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU expects French information on C.Lyonnais rescue.
newsitem.headline: EU expects French information on C.Lyonnais rescue.

text.p: The European Commission is expecting France to provide fresh information on a rescue plan for embattled French bank Crdit Lyonnais later on Tuesday, Commission sources said.
The sources said the Commission had not yet received any oral or written plan to soften the terms of a huge restructuring plan approved in July 1995.

One source said it was evident that a new request would have to be filed as the bank struggled to free itself from the burden imposed by the Commission in last year's rescue plan.
The bank is due to give half-year results on Thursday which are expected to show that it has plunged back into the red unless the rescue plan is changed retroactively to last January.
European Competition Commissioner Karel Van Miert was to give a news conference on the issue on Wednesday.
